content.what_it_is: Commented tutorial variant of plot_eta_vor.m for the FUNWAVE-TVD rip_2d case, with a User Input section (L4-L13) setting fdir to a hard-coded Windows desktop path 'C:\\Users\\Michael Lam\\Desktop\\simple_cases_input\\rip_2D/' (L8). Differences from the uncommented sibling: loads dep.out from fdir instead of ../bathy/depth_a15.txt (L17); dx/dy declared as variables (L19-L20); figure geometry papersize [7 17], position [1 1 8 12] (L29); plot window ax=[0 250 0 2000] i.e. full alongshore extent instead of 0-500 (L58). Otherwise identical processing: interactive nstart/nend via input (L32-L33; comment on previous revision nstart=280 L35), per snapshot loads umean_, vmean_, eta_, mask_ (L46-L49), masks all fields where mask<1 (L53-L56), and draws three panels: eta pcolor caxis [-0.6 1.2] with jet and south colorbar (L61-L73); vorticity from curl with caxis [-.055 .06] and dashed line at x=140 (L76-L91); depth contourf with caxis set twice ([-12 0] L96, [-12 2.5] L101) plus black quiver of u,v subsampled every 6 points scaled s=20 (L93-L106). pause(0.1) per frame (L111); nothing saved.
entities: h_bar colorbar handle L66, L82, L97

io.name: nstart, nend from console via input

unresolved: fdir mixes Windows backslashes with a trailing forward slash (L8) and lacks a semicolon so it echoes; directory named simple_cases_input though umean_/eta_ are output files
same in-place dep masking accumulation issue as the sibling (L54): masks from all previous snapshots persist
ax spans y 0-2000 (L58) though the rip_2d bathymetry from makebath.m has y up to ~500; whether a larger domain input.txt exists is not determinable here
duplicate caxis for panel 3 ([-12 0] L96 overridden by [-12 2.5] L101); icount unused
